App Service plan SKU name.
Deploy Linux broker host VMs.
Deploy Azure Virtual Desktop session hosts.
Linux host VM name prefix.
Linux host VM size.
Number of Linux host VMs to deploy.
Authentication mode for Linux host VMs.
SSH public key used when Linux host auth type is SSH.

Linux host image: 8-LVM (RHEL 8), 9-LVM (RHEL 9), rocky-9 (Rocky Linux 9), alma-9 (AlmaLinux 9) or 24_04-lts (Ubuntu 24.04). Rocky Linux 9 is a Marketplace image: the subscription must accept its terms once and be allowed to buy Marketplace images, even though it costs nothing.

Disable the screen saver and screen lock on the Linux hosts, whichever desktop they run. Enabled by default because a locked GNOME greeter inside an xrdp session often cannot be unlocked after a reconnect, which strands the host lease. Set to false to keep the lock screen, for example to satisfy a STIG or CIS idle-lock control.

Desktop the Linux hosts run in xrdp sessions: gnome (the RHEL Server with GUI group, or the Ubuntu desktop), xfce or mate. Changing it on existing hosts runs their bootstrap again at the next provision, so drain them first.
AVD host pool name.
Number of AVD session hosts to deploy.
Maximum number of sessions per AVD session host.

Opens the Linux desktop full screen. False opens it in a window on one monitor. Turn it off only once every AVD session host runs Connect-LinuxBroker.ps1 2.0.0 or later (deploy/Update-AvdHostBrokerScript.ps1): older scripts refuse the argument and the Linux Desktop app fails to open.
Spreads a full-screen Linux desktop across every monitor. False keeps it on one monitor. Turn it off only once every AVD session host runs Connect-LinuxBroker.ps1 2.0.0 or later.

Starts and stops the AVD session hosts on a schedule through an Azure Virtual Desktop scaling plan. The plan is always deployed with the session hosts; false leaves it assigned to no host pool, so the hosts stay as they are and you can assign a plan of your own instead. Azure refuses to assign the plan unless the Azure Virtual Desktop service principal holds Desktop Virtualization Power On Off Contributor on the subscription.
Starts a deallocated AVD session host when a user opens the Linux Desktop app and no running session host can take the session. Needs the same role as the scaling plan.
Windows time zone ID the scaling plan's times are in, such as UTC or Eastern Standard Time. It is separate from the broker's own scaling time zone, which the portal sets.
Start of ramp-up, as HH:mm in avdScalingPlanTimeZone. The weekday and weekend schedules use the same times.
Start of peak hours, as HH:mm. Must come after ramp-up.
Start of ramp-down, as HH:mm. Must come after peak.
Start of off-peak hours, as HH:mm. Must come after ramp-down.
Share of the AVD session hosts kept running from ramp-up until ramp-down on weekdays, rounded up to whole hosts.
Share of the running session hosts' capacity in use that makes autoscale start another one during ramp-up and peak hours.
Share of the AVD session hosts kept running from ramp-down until the next ramp-up on weekdays, rounded up to whole hosts.
Share of the running session hosts' capacity in use that makes autoscale start another one during ramp-down and off-peak hours.
Share of the AVD session hosts kept running on Saturday and Sunday. 0 lets them all stop, and Start VM on Connect starts one for the first user.
Generated by the preprovision hook: lowercase AVD session host names mapped to the value of the excludeFromScaling tag each carries, so the deployment writes the tag back.

Generated by the preprovision hook: the Linux hosts and AVD session hosts that are not running, whose VM extensions this deployment leaves out because Azure refuses to change an extension on a VM that is not running.
Object ID of the Azure Virtual Desktop service principal (app ID 9cdead84-a844-4324-93f2-b2e6bb768d07) in this tenant. The preprovision hook finds it. Without it, the role below is not assigned.

Assigns Desktop Virtualization Power On Off Contributor on the subscription to the Azure Virtual Desktop service principal, for the scaling plan and Start VM on Connect. The preprovision hook passes false when the role is already assigned, or when the signed-in account cannot assign roles on the subscription.
AVD session host VM name prefix.
AVD session host VM size.

Deploy the host monitoring: log collection from the Linux hosts and AVD session hosts, the fleet workbook, and the alerts. Set to false in a cloud that lacks data collection rules, workbooks or log search alerts. Enable-HostMonitoring.ps1 installs the Azure Monitor agent after provisioning.
Email addresses that receive the alerts, separated by commas or semicolons. For a Teams channel, use the channel's email address. Leave empty to deploy the alerts without notifications.
Refused checkouts (HTTP 409) in 15 minutes that raise an alert.
API responses with a 5xx status in 15 minutes that raise an alert.
Average end-to-end latency of the provisioned NFS share over 15 minutes, in milliseconds, that raises an alert.

fleetSnapshots: [format('| where AppRoleName == "{0}" and Message == "fleet snapshot"', parameters('apiAppName'))]
variables.hostLogLevel: | extend Level = case(RawData has_cs "ERROR", "Error", RawData has_cs "WARNING" or RawData has_cs "WARN", "Warning", RawData has_any ("failed", "cannot", "unable") or RawData has "could not", "Error", "")
variables.latestSnapshotQuery:
[join(concat(variables('fleetSnapshots'), createArray('| top 1 by TimeGenerated desc', '| project TimeGenerated, Ready = toint(Properties.ReadyHosts), InUse = toint(Properties.InUse), Waiting = toint(Properties.Waiting), Booting = toint(Properties.Booting), PoweredOn = toint(Properties.PoweredOn), Total = toint(Properties.TotalHosts), MinVMs = toint(Properties.EffectiveMinVMs), MaxVMs = toint(Properties.MaxVMs), StaleHeartbeats = toint(Properties.StaleHeartbeats), NfsUnreachable = toint(Properties.NfsUnreachable), XrdpInactive = toint(Properties.XrdpInactive), Draining = toint(Properties.Draining), Maintenance = toint(Properties.Maintenance), StartOnDemand = iff(toint(Properties.StartOnDemandEnabled) == 1, "On", "Off")')), '
')]
variables.fleetTrendQuery:
[join(concat(variables('fleetSnapshots'), createArray(format('| summarize Ready = min(toint(Properties.ReadyHosts)), InUse = max(toint(Properties.InUse)), Waiting = max(toint(Properties.Waiting)), Booting = max(toint(Properties.Booting)), PoweredOn = max(toint(Properties.PoweredOn)) by {0}', variables('workbookBin')), '| order by TimeGenerated asc')), '
')]
variables.checkoutOutcomeQuery:
[join(concat(variables('apiRequests'), createArray(variables('requestPath'), '| where Path == "/api/vms/checkout"', '| extend Outcome = case(ResultCode == "200", "Assigned (200)", ResultCode == "202", "Starting a host (202)", ResultCode == "409", "Refused (409)", toint(ResultCode) >= 500, "Failed (5xx)", strcat("Other (", ResultCode, ")"))', format('| summarize Checkouts = count() by Outcome, {0}', variables('workbookBin')), '| order by TimeGenerated asc')), '
')]
variables.checkoutLatencyQuery:
[join(concat(variables('apiRequests'), createArray('| where ResultCode == "200"', variables('requestPath'), '| where Path == "/api/vms/checkout"', format('| summarize P50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by {0}', variables('workbookBin')), '| order by TimeGenerated asc')), '
')]
variables.releaseQuery:
[join(concat(variables('apiRequests'), createArray(variables('requestPath'), '| extend Action = case(Path matches regex @"^/api/vms/[^/]+/release$", "Release", Path matches regex @"^/api/vms/[^/]+/return$", "Return", "")', '| where isnotempty(Action)', '| extend Series = strcat(Action, iff(toint(ResultCode) < 400, " succeeded", strcat(" failed (", ResultCode, ")")))', format('| summarize Requests = count() by Series, {0}', variables('workbookBin')), '| order by TimeGenerated asc')), '
')]
variables.startOnDemandQuery:
[join(createArray('union', '    (AppTraces', format('    | where AppRoleName == "{0}" and tostring(Properties.audit_action) == "vm.start_on_demand"', parameters('apiAppName')), '    | extend Series = iff(tostring(Properties.audit_outcome) == "success", "Hosts started", "Starts that failed")),', '    (AppRequests', format('    | where AppRoleName == "{0}" and ResultCode == "202"', parameters('apiAppName')), format('    {0}', variables('requestPath')), '    | where Path == "/api/vms/checkout"', '    | extend Series = "Checkouts told to wait (202)")', format('| summarize Events = count() by Series, {0}', variables('workbookBin')), '| order by TimeGenerated asc'), '
')]
variables.settingsFailureQuery:
[join(createArray('LinuxBrokerHost_CL', '| where FilePath endswith "linuxbroker-host-settings.log"', '| where RawData has_cs "ERROR" or RawData has_cs "WARNING"', '| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Level = iff(RawData has_cs "ERROR", "Error", "Warning"), Message = RawData', '| order by TimeGenerated desc', '| take 200'), '
')]
variables.hostErrorQuery:
[join(createArray('union isfuzzy=true', '    (LinuxBrokerHost_CL', format('    {0}', variables('hostLogLevel')), '    | where isnotempty(Level)', '    | extend Source = extract(@"([^/]+)$", 1, FilePath), Message = RawData),', '    (Syslog', '    | where SeverityLevel in ("emerg", "alert", "crit", "err")', '    | extend Level = "Error", Source = iff(isempty(ProcessName), strcat("syslog ", Facility), strcat("syslog ", Facility, " ", ProcessName)), Message = SyslogMessage)', '| summarize Events = count(), arg_max(TimeGenerated, Message) by Computer, Source, Level', '| project Computer, Source, Level, Events, LastSeen = TimeGenerated, LatestMessage = Message', '| order by Events desc'), '
')]
variables.nfsFailureQuery:
[join(createArray('union isfuzzy=true', '    (LinuxBrokerHost_CL', '    | where FilePath endswith "createuser.log" and RawData has "Failed to mount NFS share"', '    | extend Source = "create-user.sh"),', '    (LinuxBrokerHost_CL', '    | where FilePath endswith "linuxbroker-session-control.log" and RawData has "Could not mount the profile share"', '    | extend Source = "session-control.sh"),', '    (Syslog', '    | where Facility == "kern" and SyslogMessage has "nfs" and (SyslogMessage has "not responding" or SyslogMessage has "timed out")', '    | extend Source = "kernel", RawData = SyslogMessage)', '| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Source, Message = RawData', '| order by TimeGenerated desc', '| take 500'), '
')]
variables.avdEventQuery:
[join(createArray('Event', '| where Source == "LinuxBrokerScript" or EventLog == "Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-RDPClient/Operational"', '| where EventLevelName in ("Critical", "Error", "Warning")', '| summarize Events = count(), arg_max(TimeGenerated, RenderedDescription) by Computer, Source, Level = EventLevelName', '| project Computer, Source, Level, Events, LastSeen = TimeGenerated, LatestMessage = RenderedDescription', '| order by Events desc'), '
')]
variables.noReadyHostsAlertQuery:
[join(concat(variables('fleetSnapshots'), createArray('| extend Ready = toint(Properties.ReadyHosts), MinVMs = toint(Properties.EffectiveMinVMs), Waiting = toint(Properties.Waiting)', '| summarize Snapshots = count(), Short = countif(Ready == 0 and (MinVMs > 0 or Waiting > 0)), MostWaiting = max(Waiting)', '| where Snapshots > 0 and Short == Snapshots')), '
')]
variables.unhealthyHostsAlertQuery:
[join(concat(variables('fleetSnapshots'), createArray('| extend Stale = toint(Properties.StaleHeartbeats), Nfs = toint(Properties.NfsUnreachable), Xrdp = toint(Properties.XrdpInactive)', '| summarize Snapshots = count(), Lowest = min(Stale + Nfs + Xrdp), StaleHeartbeats = max(Stale), NfsUnreachable = max(Nfs), XrdpInactive = max(Xrdp)', '| where Snapshots > 0 and Lowest > 0')), '
')]
variables.refusedCheckoutAlertQuery:
[join(concat(variables('apiRequests'), createArray('| where ResultCode == "409"', variables('requestPath'), '| where Path == "/api/vms/checkout"')), '
')]

logAlerts.name: no-ready-hosts
logAlerts.description: For 15 minutes every fleet snapshot showed no ready Linux host while the scaling minimum is above 0 or users are waiting. Check the Linux hosts and the scaling settings.

logAlerts.name: fleet-snapshot-missing
logAlerts.description: The scaling run has logged no fleet snapshot for 15 minutes. The task function, the API or the database may be down, or SQL script 157 is not applied yet.

logAlerts.name: checkouts-refused
logAlerts.description: The broker refused checkouts (HTTP 409) in the last 15 minutes, so users could not get a Linux desktop.

logAlerts.name: unhealthy-hosts
logAlerts.description: For 15 minutes every fleet snapshot showed a Linux host with a stale heartbeat, an unreachable home share or no xrdp service. The workbook lists the hosts' errors.

logAlerts.name: api-errors
logAlerts.description: The broker API answered requests with a 5xx status in the last 15 minutes.

content.json:
## Linux Broker fleet
The scaling run logs a fleet snapshot every five minutes. Host logs arrive once deploy/Enable-HostMonitoring.ps1 has installed the Azure Monitor agent on the hosts.

items.name: latest-snapshot
items.content: [union(variables('workbookBaseQuery'), createObject('title', 'Latest fleet snapshot', 'query', variables('latestSnapshotQuery'), 'visualization', 'table', 'noDataMessage', 'No fleet snapshot in this time range. The API logs one every five minutes once SQL script 157 is applied.'))]

items.name: fleet-trend
items.content: [union(variables('workbookBaseQuery'), createObject('title', 'Hosts over time (fewest ready, most in use, waiting, booting and powered on)', 'query', variables('fleetTrendQuery'), 'visualization', 'timechart'))]

items.name: checkout-latency
items.content: [union(variables('workbookBaseQuery'), createObject('title', 'Checkout time in milliseconds (50th and 95th percentile)', 'query', variables('checkoutLatencyQuery'), 'visualization', 'timechart'))]

items.name: settings-failures
items.content: [union(variables('workbookBaseQuery'), createObject('title', 'Host settings that could not be applied', 'query', variables('settingsFailureQuery'), 'visualization', 'table', 'noDataMessage', 'No host setting errors or warnings in this time range.'))]

items.name: host-errors
items.content: [union(variables('workbookBaseQuery'), createObject('title', 'Errors and warnings by Linux host', 'query', variables('hostErrorQuery'), 'visualization', 'table', 'noDataMessage', 'No host errors in this time range, or the Azure Monitor agent is not installed yet.'))]

items.name: nfs-failures
items.content: [union(variables('workbookBaseQuery'), createObject('title', 'NFS home share failures', 'query', variables('nfsFailureQuery'), 'visualization', 'table', 'noDataMessage', 'No NFS mount failures in this time range.'))]

items.name: avd-events
items.content: [union(variables('workbookBaseQuery'), createObject('title', 'Errors and warnings by AVD session host', 'query', variables('avdEventQuery'), 'visualization', 'table', 'noDataMessage', 'No AVD session host errors in this time range, or the Azure Monitor agent is not installed yet.'))]
